name: Survey tile in Leo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.3 degrees south of the ecliptic in Leo, imaged by SPHEREx 18 times in 8 visits over 29 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 30 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 29 hours starting 2025-12-02, at wavelengths from 1.27 to 4.99 µm. The pipeline found 2 moving objects.
